author: Arch91
quote: A Disappointing Step BackwardsRockstar has stripped away what made GTA special: player freedom. Everything feels restricted, scripted, and overly controlled. The wanted system is frustrating, the story is boring, and Jason’s voice acting is underwhelming. On top of that, the choppy 30 FPS makes the experience feel outdated. After more than a decade of waiting, this feels less like an evolution and more like a regression. Rockstar prioritized cinematic presentation over actual gameplay.
